content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Step 65. Slide the armchair into the corner (7 minutes)
Step 66. Overlap the edges of the floor blankets (5 minutes)
Step 67. Drape the final blackout curtain over the top (10 minutes)
Step 68. Clear a path from the door to the fort (8 minutes)
Step 69. Roll out the padding for the entrance (6 minutes)
Step 70. Tape the edges of the sheets to the wall (5 minutes)
Step 71. Position the tall dining chairs in a square (10 minutes)
Step 72. Gather the necessary snacks and drinks (15 minutes)

Step 74. Organize the work area for efficiency (10 minutes)

Step 76. Review the blueprint for any missed details (5 minutes)
Step 77. Anchor the fabric to the table legs (4 minutes)
Step 78. Pick out the most comfortable pajamas (10 minutes)
Step 79. Lay the final soft fleece layer on the floor (5 minutes)
Step 80. Select the primary structural supports (5 minutes)
Step 81. Toss in the extra decorative cushions (3 minutes)
Step 82. Remove any tripping hazards (4 minutes)
Step 83. Light the battery-operated candles (2 minutes)
Step 84. Adjust the lamp to point toward the ceiling (3 minutes)
Step 85. Place the snack tray on the flat surface (2 minutes)
Step 86. Fluff the pillows for maximum comfort (5 minutes)
Step 87. Cut the tape into manageable strips (4 minutes)
Step 88. Prop open the entrance flap (2 minutes)
Step 89. Drape the side walls with thin linens (6 minutes)
Step 90. Test the light levels inside the fort (3 minutes)
Step 91. Fasten the roof to the side walls (10 minutes)
Step 92. Gather the necessary tools and fasteners (10 minutes)
Step 93. Place the cooler bag near the entrance (5 minutes)
Step 94. Check the tension of the main support line (5 minutes)
Step 95. Clear the floor of any toys or shoes (10 minutes)
Step 96. Tighten the knots on the support ropes (5 minutes)
Step 97. Tuck the fabric under the heavy books (4 minutes)
Step 98. Move the coffee table into the center (8 minutes)
Step 99. Tape the fort rules to the outside wall (3 minutes)
Step 100. Position the backrest pillows against the wall (5 minutes)
